Python AST location lookup is bounded to standard parser node location fields.
Python AST assertion lookup is bounded to standard parser node location fields.
Python AST test-node lookup is bounded to standard parser node location fields.
Invariant naming reads only the callable __name__ or the declared invariant name attribute; these are the fixed fields used to identify one invariant in the finite explorer report.
Invariant descriptions read only the declared description field from the invariant object; an absent or newly selected field remains unresolved.
Invariant evaluation calls only the declared check field on the invariant object; the finite invariant contract owns this exact selector.
Candidate discovery reads only the finite project-neutral implementation-inventory protocol fields and never accepts them as authority.

The current serializer normalization iterates the fixed RuntimeTestResult dataclass field list; it cannot select an open runtime member and any new field changes the current contract and model identity.
The current leaf-evidence normalizer iterates the fixed RuntimeTestLeafEvidence field list; a new field or selector is a direct current-model change, not an implicitly compatible extension.
The current report normalizer iterates the fixed RuntimeTestEvidenceReport field list; the bounded protocol is explicit and any shape change must rebuild current authority.
Pytest adapter fallback reads only named fields from a plugin result object through a fixed read helper; mapping keys and accepted outcome fields remain validated by the native result contract.

Reservation plan reconciliation iterates one fixed field-to-field map declared in the current protocol; selectors cannot be supplied by callers, and adding a selector changes the current model contract.
Directory enumeration combines existing facade globals with the declared public and eager-private export catalogue; it does not invoke selectors.

The current facade resolves only catalogue names, declared eager-private exports and legal submodules; successful resolution caches the declared export under that name. Unknown names raise AttributeError.
The current lazy facade imports its declared eager owner. This is the explicit current facade protocol, not a statically literal import selector contract.
The current eager facade owns the declared module export assembly formerly located at the package module. Explicit star imports and declared export maps populate this facade only.
Serialization reads fields(self) of this current typed dataclass; it does not invoke dynamically selected functions.
Serialization reads fields(self) of the current typed objective dataclass.
Serialization reads fields(self) of the current typed bound objective dataclass.
The validated target kind selects exactly target_obligation_ids, target_invariant_ids or desired_terminal_state_ids from the typed contribution; all original binding checks remain authoritative.
Serialization reads fields(self) of the current typed architecture action target.
Pointer validation reads and canonicalizes its explicitly listed typed tuple fields; existing pointer identity checks remain authoritative.
Identity serialization reads this pointer dataclass fields except pointer_id, preserving the original identity computation.
Serialization reads fields(self) of the current typed responsibility fact.
Identity serialization reads the declared dataclass fields of the current path quality source.
Validation reads the fields declared by this current typed semantic evidence dataclass and applies its existing exact validators.
Serialization reads fields(self) of this current typed semantic evidence dataclass.
Failure diagnostics compare fields(BehaviorCaseContract) in the actual and expected typed cases after exact materialization mismatch; the getter does not change acceptance.

contracts.effect: functional-contract:python_function_state_verification:effect:declared writes, independent implementation replay and input rejection without execution

contracts.state: functional-contract:problem_corpus_coverage:state:independent original and mutated per-case outcomes without hidden terminal statuses
contracts.effect: functional-contract:problem_corpus_coverage:effect:one actual baseline followed by pure independently specified report mutations
contracts.output: functional-contract:problem_corpus_coverage:output:actual family case-kind/bug-class/variant-depth coverage and result aggregation
contracts.completion: functional-contract:problem_corpus_coverage:completion:failed or unknown terminal, absent class, low depth or changed denominator blocks completeness
contracts.semantics: functional-contract:problem_corpus_coverage:semantics:benchmark aggregation and coverage; no arbitrary software behavior or production workload proof

contracts.output: functional-contract:evidence_storage_lifecycle:output:actual identity verification, deterministic blockers and storage receipts only after physical effects
contracts.completion: functional-contract:evidence_storage_lifecycle:completion:foreign/tampered/stale plan, invalid current, conflicting restore or unconfirmed cleanup blocks
contracts.semantics: functional-contract:evidence_storage_lifecycle:semantics:storage reachability and retained declared lease observations; storage receipt does not prove target checks
